findings.motion: Co-sponsor of SB 715, Student Voter ID Grant Program/CCs (filed 2025-03-25)
findings.note: She is listed as a co-sponsor. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/Senate/HTML/S715v1.html) appropriates $500,000 for grants of up to $20,000 to community colleges to upgrade equipment to produce student ID cards usable to vote in person, and directs the State Board of Elections to review community college applications to have student ID cards approved as photo ID. The bill was re-referred to Appropriations on 2025-03-26.
subjects: student ID accepted as voter ID
